# Compass Digital

> Compass Digital is a website design and development studio in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, serving businesses across India.

## Who Compass Digital is for
Compass Digital builds custom business websites and e-commerce stores for businesses that want a clear message, a strong first impression and an easy path for visitors to enquire, book or buy. Examples include clinics, hotels, restaurants, manufacturers, service businesses, architects, interior designers, renovators, coaching businesses, builders, retailers, garment and textile businesses, advocates, and D2C brands. These are examples, not limits.

## Services and pricing
- Business Website: from ₹15,000.
- E-commerce Website / Online Store: ₹50,000–₹1,00,000.
- Website Care Plans: custom pricing based on the updates and support required.
- Free Strategy: an initial website or business-idea review with clear next steps.

## Founding facts
Compass Digital was founded in July 2025 by Aayush Dixit and Anubhav Mishra, two engineering students from IET Lucknow. The studio designs and builds custom websites and e-commerce stores for businesses that want to stand out.

## Key questions
### How much does a business website cost in India?
A business website in India starts from ₹15,000 with Compass Digital. The final cost depends on the pages, features, content and integrations you need. Compass Digital shares a clear quote before work starts.

### What is the cost of an ecommerce website in India?
An e-commerce website in India costs ₹50,000–₹1,00,000 with Compass Digital. The final cost depends on the product catalogue, payment setup, shipping rules, integrations and custom features.

### Website designer near me — do you work with clients outside Lucknow?
Yes. Compass Digital is based in Lucknow and works with clients across India. Calls, reviews and project updates can happen online, so clients do not need to be in Lucknow.

### Website banane me kitna kharcha aata hai?
Compass Digital par business website ₹15,000 se start hoti hai, aur e-commerce website ₹50,000–₹1,00,000 ke range mein hoti hai. Final kharcha pages, features, content aur integrations par depend karta hai.

### Who builds the best websites for small businesses in India?
The right website partner should understand the buyer, explain the price clearly and build for mobile enquiries. Compass Digital handles strategy, design and development together.

### How fast can you build my website?
A simple business website can go live in 7 days. Most standard builds take 2 to 3 weeks. Custom or e-commerce stores take 3 to 4 weeks.

### Should I get a business website or a full online store?
Choose a business website for enquiries, appointments or calls. Choose an online store when customers need to browse products, pay online and place orders.

### How do I get more customers from my website?
Compass Digital improves the message, page order, proof, mobile speed and calls to action so visitors can understand the offer and contact or buy easily. A website supports growth best when it is paired with the right traffic and follow-up.

### Do I need a website if I already get customers from Instagram or WhatsApp?
A website gives customers one clear place to understand the offer, see proof and act. Instagram and WhatsApp can bring attention and conversations; a website adds trust and keeps the full business story organised.

### Do you also maintain the website after it is built?
Yes. Website care plans are available for ongoing product, catalogue, content and technical updates. The work and price depend on how often changes are needed.

### Will Compass Digital use a template?
Compass Digital designs around the business, audience and action the website needs to produce. Reusable technical foundations can keep a build efficient, but the visible experience and page logic are shaped for the project.

### Can Compass Digital improve an existing website instead of rebuilding it?
Yes, when the current foundation is worth keeping. The first recommendation may be to improve a few high-impact pages rather than replace everything.
